articles.summary: Smith Douglas Homes Corp. (NYSE: SDHC) (“Smith Douglas” or the “Company”) today announced third quarter results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Q3 2026 Results as compared to Q3 2025: Home closings increased 5% to 831 Home closing revenue increased 0.2% to $262.5 million Home closing gross margin of 16.3% compared to 21.0% Net new home orders increased 13% to 777 Backlog homes increased 25% to 947 Pretax income of $3.3 million compared to $17.2 million Earnings of $0.07 per diluted share compared to $0.24 Debt-to-book capitalization of 18.8% compared to 9.0% at December 31, 2025 Active community count increased 15% to 113 at quarter end Total controlled lots increased 2% to 24,724 Repurchased 28,370 shares of Class A common stock for $0.3 million “We continued to execute with discipline during the third quarter despite increasingly challenging housing market conditions,” said Greg Bennett, Chief Executive Officer and Vice Chairman of Smith Douglas Homes.
articles.title: Smith Douglas Homes Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
